subject: Malaysia M-510: protective-coating review and sample
body:
For RD's protective-coating review, M-510 requires formulation assessment. Its TDS describes chloride-process rutile with zirconium/aluminium treatment; the listed application is wall latex paint.

Our REACH registration certificate is available for review.

I've attached the M-510 TDS and REACH information for your review.

We can provide a free 1 kg sample.

Shall we arrange a sample for your laboratory team's evaluation?
